findings.subject: Exact-main baseline is not frozen
findings.command: git status --short; git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse origin/main; git diff --check
findings.commandResult: HEAD and origin/main resolved and diff check passed, but the working tree contains modified and untracked implementation files; audit-baseline.json is absent.
findings.expectedBehavior: One clean immutable baseline with a manifest and retained exact-head command evidence.
findings.observedBehavior: The T0 consumer and related solver/package changes are present only in a dirty mixed working tree.
findings.engineeringImpact: The passing checks cannot be reproduced from the named commit and cannot qualify a release.
findings.requiredCorrection: Freeze a clean exact release candidate, create audit-baseline.json, retain command output and exit status, and repeat the audit.
findings.retestCommand: npm ci && git status --short && git diff --check && npm run gate

findings.subject: T0 consumer is not the complete application consumer
findings.commandResult: Exit 0; 13 [SIMULATED] T0 checks and the anti-drift check passed.
findings.expectedBehavior: One consumer compiles source through B-2.5/B-3.0, solves, recovers interfaces, performs configured nozzle/code assessments and seals a complete current result.
findings.observedBehavior: The consumer accepts sealed B-2.5/B-3.0 records, executes through B-3.4 and requires interfaceLoadResults, nozzleAssessments and codeResults to remain null.
findings.engineeringImpact: The stage cannot publish governed support, anchor, nozzle or application-level B31.3 results.
findings.requiredCorrection: Extend or supersede T0 with the missing source, interface, nozzle and code orchestration while preserving fail-closed parent currency.

findings.subject: Consumer check registration does not match the PDF gate
findings.commandResult: check:linear-piping-analysis-consumer is registered directly in gate but is not included in check:lfea-core.
findings.expectedBehavior: The PDF requires registration in package.json, check:lfea-core and the full repository gate.
findings.observedBehavior: Two of the three registration locations are present.
findings.engineeringImpact: Running check:lfea-core alone does not exercise the application-consumer boundary.
findings.requiredCorrection: Register the consumer in check:lfea-core or formally revise the governing rule with an explicit downstream-gate rationale.
findings.retestCommand: npm run check:lfea-core && npm run gate

findings.subject: Support, anchor and nozzle interface authority is missing
findings.command: Source inspection and npm run check:linear-piping-analysis-consumer
findings.commandResult: The source guard forbids premature interface mechanics and the T0 result keeps interfaceLoadResults null.
findings.expectedBehavior: Qualified attachment/frame/offset/six-DOF contracts and reaction, local-frame and reference-point recovery.
findings.observedBehavior: No piping application interface contract or recovery package exists.
findings.engineeringImpact: Support, anchor and nozzle actions cannot be issued as governed results.
findings.requiredCorrection: Implement and benchmark interface definitions, constrained reaction grouping, local transformations, offset transfer, sign conventions and envelopes.
findings.retestCommand: npm run check:lfea-interfaces && npm run check:lfea-interface-frames && npm run check:lfea-envelopes

findings.subject: Upstream load/code packages exist but application orchestration is missing
findings.command: npm run check:lfea-core; npm run check:linear-piping-analysis-consumer
findings.commandResult: Both commands exited 0; T0 codeResults and nozzleAssessments remain null.
findings.expectedBehavior: Immutable application load cases, versioned combinations, recovery-bound B31.3 results and configured nozzle allowables.
findings.observedBehavior: B-3.0 and B-4.0 pass independently but are not joined to interface recovery or T0 output.
findings.engineeringImpact: The application cannot issue nozzle utilization or B31.3 compliance results.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind source load orchestration, recovered case/category actions, B31.3 compilation and caller-supplied nozzle profiles.
findings.retestCommand: npm run check:lfea-thermal && npm run check:lfea-allowables && npm run check:linear-piping-analysis-consumer

findings.subject: Piping result presentation and export are absent
findings.command: Search production src imports for linear-piping-analysis-consumer
findings.commandResult: No production module outside the consumer package imports or presents the T0 result.
findings.expectedBehavior: Read-only stale-safe support/nozzle/B31.3 surfaces and byte-deterministic exports with parent hashes.
findings.observedBehavior: No piping result presenter or equipment-load export exists.
findings.engineeringImpact: There is no qualified route from T0 output to a user-visible or exportable engineering result.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add read-only current-result presenters, stale blocking and deterministic exports after A4/A5 are qualified.
findings.retestCommand: npm run check:lfea-interface-e2e && npm run check:lfea-interface-export

findings.subject: Release evidence pyramid is incomplete
findings.command: Review source documents, repository checks and supplied evidence
findings.commandResult: Analytical and simulated checks exist; no real imported piping model, commercial corroboration, signed release disposition or rollback rehearsal was supplied.
findings.expectedBehavior: All six qualification levels and exact-head release evidence are complete.
findings.observedBehavior: Levels based on real model, commercial comparison and release operations are absent.
findings.engineeringImpact: Production engineering validity and release readiness are unproven.
findings.requiredCorrection: Complete real-model reconciliation, selected commercial corroboration, performance qualification, exact-head CI, limitations, rollback and signed disposition.
findings.retestCommand: Project-specific FEA-REAL-01 command TBD, followed by npm run gate

findings.subject: The update incorrectly reports workspace-consumers as missing
findings.command: Test-Path src/core/workspace-consumers; enumerate its source files
findings.commandResult: The directory exists and contains index, registry, readiness, validators and related modules.
findings.expectedBehavior: The blocker statement names only paths that are actually absent.
findings.observedBehavior: The update groups an existing directory with missing lfea-007 modules.
findings.engineeringImpact: Remediation scope and repository-hygiene findings are misstated.
findings.requiredCorrection: Remove src/core/workspace-consumers from the missing-path list and identify the actual missing consumer/controller/view paths.

findings.subject: The update uses conflicting public-gateway wording
findings.command: Compare the update baseline blocker list with its Current T0 implementation section
findings.commandResult: A public T0 gateway exists, but a complete source-to-presentation gateway does not.
findings.expectedBehavior: Documentary status distinguishes stage-local and complete gateways.
findings.observedBehavior: The unqualified phrase no public piping execution gateway conflicts with the later T0 section.
findings.engineeringImpact: Readers can misinterpret whether any application boundary exists.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use no complete end-to-end public piping gateway.
findings.retestCommand: Review docs/priority2FEAupdate.md for consistent gateway terminology

findings.subject: lfea-007 certification assets are orphaned and unregistered
findings.commandResult: Both exit 1: the package script is missing and the direct suite fails on missing src/core/lfea-consumer/index.js.
findings.expectedBehavior: A registered, executable continuum Local FEA consumer suite or a formally retired work package.
findings.observedBehavior: Scripts and certification workflow remain while required consumer and workspace modules are absent.
findings.engineeringImpact: The repository carries non-executable certification claims and ambiguous Local FEA ownership.
findings.requiredCorrection: Repair and register lfea-007 or formally retire it through a separate reviewed work package; do not treat it as piping T0 evidence.
findings.retestCommand: npm run check:lfea.007:static && npm run check:lfea.007:browser
